description: Per-document decoders for scripts/normalize_thai.py. Default font repair and text rules apply to every document. dropped_sara_am converts consonant/tone+space+SARA AA to SARA AM; without it the space is only deleted, because after font repair most such spaces are layout artifacts (e.g. รองเท้ า). Enable it only after checking every remaining case.

ckd-public-kidney-prevention-tips.evidence: 2026-10-06: Type1 fonts with /Differences emit MacRoman-looking text; MacRoman bytes decode as TIS-620 with Mac Thai positional marks (checked against rendered PDF page 20).

lipid-dms-stroke-public-manual.evidence: 2026-10-06: PSL-Similanya simple TrueType fonts without ToUnicode emit cp1252 Latin text for TIS-620 bytes, e.g. page 20 heading decodes to the Thai manual title.
